title: Mike Florio and Chris Simms apologize for 'comments that some found offensive' after being called out by NFL

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Mike Florio and Chris Simms apologize for 'comments that some found offensive' after being called out by NFL
sources.description: "PFT Live" hosts Mike Florio and Chris Simms were called out by the NFL for 'inappropriate and offensive' comments about Mike Vrabel's mustache that included thinly veiled references to Hitler.
